messages.subject: ARE YOU TO BE TRUSTED???
messages.body:
Thanks for writing. making friends at this stage of my life is very important to me and hoping to find someone with a good heart to serve the people if entrusted with a great and monetary task. here is little about me, I'm Mrs Lilian Johnson Paul am a Deaf and Dumb widow to late Johnson Paul, 57 years of age suffering from long time breast cancer. and from all results, my state of health is really deteriorating day by day,and its obvious i may not live long according to my doctor. i wish at this stage that i have children and maybe grand-children around me but was not bless to have any due to critical situation that recently happens to i and my beloved families.



One of the reason am looking for someone trustworthy is because of this wealth i inherited from my late husband. and since i have a short time to live,will like to give it out to the less privilege, motherless, widows, cancer patients etc, its easy to give it to the government but i do know their officials will pocket it. i want the money to go round and add values to the life of those that really needs it.



I am willing to donate the sum of $5,000,000 which is the major inheritance my late husband left behind in my name, do you think if i entrust you with this task, you will do it with utmost truth and sincerity and with the fear of God?? hope to hear from you again.



To proceed with the charity work for the less privilege. I cannot continue to do all these by myself anymore. I strongly desire to reach out to the poor and needy people but I would prefer to continue this with the assistance of a kind person.



The Bible made us to understand that blessed is the hand that giveth. I took this decision because I don't have any child that will inherit this money and my husband relatives are not Believers and I don't want my husband's efforts to be used by unbelievers. I don't want a situation where this money will be used in an ungodly way. This is why I am taking this decision. I am not afraid of death hence i know where I am going. I know that I am going to be in the bosom of the Lord.

Exodus 14 VS 14 says that the Lord will fight my case and I shall hold my peace.



I don't need any telephone communication in this regard because of my health hence the presence of my husband's relatives around me always I don't want them to know about this development. With God all things are possible. I want you and the Church to always pray for me because the Lord is my shepherd. My happiness is that I lived a life of a worthy Christian. Whoever that wants to serve the Lord must serve him in spirit and Truth. Please always be prayerful all through your life.



This is why with God in my heart i contact you and i want you to contact me so we be in contact with all the poor souls out there. Give new lives, hopes and days. I have come to find out that wealth acquisition without Christ is vanity and i hope you'll agree with this also. I will be praying hard that Satan will not stop this effort . Do contact me and i will tell you more of what you wish to know . Note that the Lord have a great reason for me contacting you and i will be very grateful if you will heed to the call of the Lord by replying to me on my personal email address on (
scammer_438
).



Any delay in your reply will give me room in sourcing another church or individual for this same purpose, please assure me that you will act accordingly as I stated herein. Hoping to receive your reply on my mail now.



Yours in Christ,

Remember me in your daily prayers.

Mrs,Lilian Paul


scammer_438

messages.subject: IF GOD SAYS YES, NO ONE CAN SAY NO
messages.body:
*My dear beloved,*













*I want you to notice that I don't know you and I don't even know who you
are or where you come from, but the Lord I serve is so loving and helpful
that he never forgets his own people, I've been thinking. of what to do
with these funds over a period of years simply because I know the money is
no longer of use to me simply due to the stage 4 cancer I am currently
battling.I am a very devout person and it was when I was praying some time
ago that the Lord revealed to me whether I should call it a dream, vision
or trance. That I should go into the world and bless the world with what
the Almighty God has used to bless me and my late husband. The vision seems
so wonderful and I was so upset that I had to fast and pray about it for a
day and then someone in my church interpreted the meaning of my dreams for
me by telling me that I am having something that is needed in the world.
and he wanted me to use it to bless the world and the person asked me to
think very carefully because it is the voice of the Lord that has spoken to
me and I must listen to it.I searched very well and I remember that I am
having the fund that my husband and I had worked on for so many years and I
contacted the Bank in Africa as the beneficiary of the funds and they
confirmed the owner of the funds. and they ask me to come and get it
exactly when it's ready, but I should know when I'm going so that proper
arrangements can be made at that time, but it's a shame I can't go, which
you already know.I had another dream that made me realize that I should not
be in possession of the money and should go into the world and find someone
in the world to distribute the funds in a godly manner. So I decided to
search with the name related to a woman who took good care of me when my
runaway parents left me. I grew up in a motherless baby home, so I told my
nurse to help me get an Internet account. After that, I decided to search.
I got about 1065 profiles and I prayed for them and you know what's funny?
Among all the profiles that I chose, it was yours that the Lord has chosen
to distribute these funds as a sacrifice of the Lord to the world.It is a
means by which you have been committed to the Lord and this will make you
closer to him as well and I am very sure that he certainly must have a
reason why he wants you to do this on his behalf, please be strong and have
faith . in you and me and make me realize that you will do it just because
I know you can do it and I see you doing it well among everyone else...I
hope to read from you as soon as possible and please make sure you never
forget me in your daily prayers, God bless you and your family, say a
prayer for that and you will smell it around you. The Lord will not come
down to call his own people. I will send you someone now he has sent me to
you.May God bless you abundantly in his riches... Amen.*

*Mrs,Lilian Johnson Paul*

Ivonne Juez Abuchacra de Baki

.

.

I am Mrs. Füsun Gültekin, a Bank Officer here in Istanbul Turkey with COMMERCIAL BANKING COMPANY, TURKIYE ISBANK. I believe it is the wish of God for me to come across you now. Address 

Mobile number 

A scan copy of your identification

messages.subject: Re: Dear
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Jackson,
Oh my, this sounds important, but I’m a bit muddled. Which office are you with—Canada, Spain, or the United Nations? What is the “Panel,” please?
You asked for a “scan copy of your…” of my what? I don’t do attachments. Could you mail papers instead, on letterhead with a stamp?
Also, is it USD or Canadian? How did you pick me?
My name shows as Marge P. Park, sometimes Marjorie Petunia Parker—does that matter?
Captain Crumbs keeps chirping “verify.” What physical office address and phone can I call to confirm?

Best wishes,
Adrienne

messages.subject: NNPC
messages.body:
Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation,



       Herbert Macaulay Way,



       Garki, Abuja. ,



It is with trust and confidence that I write to make this urgent business proposal to you. I was assigned by two of my colleagues to seek a foreign partner who will assist us in providing a convenient foreign account in any designated bank abroad for the transfer of us$35,500,000.00 pending on our arrival in your country for utilization and disbursement with the owner of the account.



This amount results from a deliberate inflation of the value of a contract awarded by our corporation- The Nigeria National Petroleum Corporation (NNPC) to an expatriate company, the contract has been executed and payment made to the original contractor remaining the over-invoiced amount of us$35.5 million, which we now want to transfer out of the country in our favour for disbursement among ourselves. The transfer of this money can only be possible with the help of a foreigner who will be presented as the beneficiary of the funds.



It will interest you to know that as government officials, we are not allowed to operate foreign accounts, and this is the reason why we decided to contact you. we have agreed that if you/your company can act as the beneficiary of this fund (us$35,500,000.00 million) 25% of the total sum will be for you for providing the account while 5% will be set aside for the expenses incurred during the cost of transfer of the fund into your account while 70% will be reserved for us.



We hereby solicit for your assistance in providing a convenient account number in a designated bank abroad where this fund would be transferred. We intend to come over there on the completion of this transfer to secure our own share of the money.



Please note that we have been careful and have made all arrangements towards the success and smooth transfer of the fund to your account before you. For security reasons and confidentiality of this transaction, we demand that you should not expose this proposal and the entire transaction to anybody.



We are putting so much trust in you with the hope that you would not betray us or sit on this money when it is finally transferred into your account, be rest assured that this transaction is 100% risk free. If this proposal is acceptable to you, kindly forward the following information, full names, tel numbers, address and your full banking details.



Yours faithfully,



Demola Aderemi..

messages.subject: Re: NNPC
messages.body:
Hello Demola,

Your message seems to have bits missing. What exact amount—in numbers? What percent is mine, what for expenses, and what for you? I want the math to add up.

Do you need a foreign account or a foreign accountant? I don’t do online banking. My small credit union frowns on surprises, and I won’t share any banking details.

If this is legitimate, explain step by step, in plain English (no abbreviations), how this works and what you expect me to do. No links or attachments.

Which company did NNPC pay? Why me? Please send your name, work address, government ID, and a phone number. I might call later—after the church bake sale and once Captain Biscuits stops yelling “Loose change!” Also, put this on official letterhead.

What time zone are you in?

Best wishes,
Kathleen

Demola, happy National Day.

I’m still lost. Please answer plainly, in the email body (no links/attachments):

1) Exact amount: $35,500,000 or $100,000? Pick one. Write with commas.
2) Split: X% to me, Y% to expenses (cap it at $____), Z% to you/colleagues. Must total 100%.

Captain Biscuits is shrieking; tomatoes need watering. Maybe a quick call later this week—give me a 15‑minute window WAT.

Kathleen

messages.body:
Phone is tricky—my landline crackles and Captain Biscuits shrieks. We can try later, after the church bake sale. What number will you call from (+234…)? What time zone are you in, with UTC offset? Lagos is usually UTC+1, not GMT—please confirm.

- Full document list with sample wording; your letterhead text; your ID details; office address; +234 phone; MOU draft.

Also, what does “NNPC PED” stand for?

Running to the garden swap now—write it out and I’ll read carefully.

Best wishes,
Kathleen

I earn a living in the oil industry as an independent Feasibility/Project Management Consultant to oil refineries and other oil industries in Southern African, East Africa and some parts of Asia. We are based in Johannesburg RSA. Our mandate includes identifying specific licensed crude oil export/ marketing firms and recommending these firms to the oil refineries for supply of crude oil to the refineries.

 On my desk is a mandate from one the refineries to arrange for crude oil purchase from Libya for up to 2,000,000 barrels on monthly bases for 12 calendar months.



 The essence of my reaching out to you is the fact that am in the process of building a middle man structure to mediate between the 2 parties involved before the contract is signed. You may be wondering why I cannot do it by myself right? The honest fact is that as a consultant to these oil refineries, we are not allowed to act as suppliers of crude oil to them as well, hence the reason I need a trustworthy person outside my work circle in order to maintain a discreet profile.



 I wish to extend this partnership to you my friend to build a middle man structure with you, while I work from the back to guide you. Our commission/brokerage as middle persons is between $2 - $3 per barrel as case may be. So if the target of 2M barrels is met monthly we stand to share $4M - $6M every month for a span of 12 months with possible extension.



 Worry less about the speedy sales as I have contacts within oil producing country's top officials for license of crude oil export/lifting to any firm I so present for this business. Therefore if you can be able to handle this transaction with honesty and integrity, you should come back to me immediately for more details.

 John Monk

messages.subject: DETAILS
messages.body:
Dear Muriel, Thanks for your well received message. Your reply I believed is an indication that you are willing to be part of this business opportunity. Also this will not prevent you from doing your normal business as this project is on the side for making extra income as a legal crude oil license holder. As long as you are going to be sincere towards this project, we will have reasons to celebrate in the end. The business is completely legal and you have nothing to worry about. 
PLEASE READ THE DETAILS AND GET BACK TO ME 

You are to become a middleman/sales agent between the buyer and the National Oil Corporation of Libya (NOC). You will be corresponding between the NOC (seller) and (buyer) electronically from the comfort of your home. To set the ball rolling in this venture, the first step is for us to apply for the crude oil export and marketing license from the NOC. 

There are two ways through which you can apply for the license, one you can apply in your company name if you have a registered company or you can apply as an individual in your name. I will draft a license application letter for you to fill and send to the Licensing operations department of the NOC to apply for the license. You will type the license application letter into your official company letterhead paper (If you want to apply in your company name) and send the application directly to the licensing operations department of  NOC which is responsible for issuing crude oil sales licenses. I will direct you step by step from the process of acquiring the license to become the middleman to the process of selling your allocated product to the BUYER. 

I will link you up with one company which has intentions to buy 2 million barrels of Libyan crude on monthly bases for 1 year. (So the commissions are paid out every month throughout the duration of the 12month contract.)This implies that you will not have problems finding buyers. I will guide you to apply for the license and also guide you step by step in all your correspondence between NOC and the BUYER until the BUYER pays the NOC for the crude after which your commissions will be calculated and paid into your nominated receiving bank account. 

Getting this license will give you the legal authorization of the NOC to become their sales agent. Please be informed that getting this license is never a walk in the park because of the prospective nature of the commissions paid to license owners every month. The licenses are usually given to the families and relatives of the top government officials as they did not want people to benefit from such a lucrative venture. But I have someone in the ministry of oil and gas who will assist us in getting the license. I will guide you to apply for this license and once you obtain it, the new doors will open. So I will need you to confirm if you want to apply for the license in your company name or in your individual name though company name is preferable. messages.body:
Ik hoop dat deze correspondentie u in goede gezondheid bereikt.



Mijn oprechte excuses voor de vertraging in het beantwoorden van uw vraag. Vanwege het grote aantal lopende rechtszaken liep onze reactie onvermijdelijk vertraging op. Ik wil u echter verzekeren dat ons kantoor zowel competent als goed gepositioneerd is om u te helpen bij het oplossen van de kwestie van uw achtergelaten tegoeden, die momenteel door het Amerikaanse ministerie van Justitie in administratieve bewaring zijn geplaatst.



Toen ik vorige week op het districtskantoor van het Amerikaanse ministerie van Justitie in Houston verscheen ter vertegenwoordiging van een andere cliлnt in een soortgelijke zaak, stuitte ik op documentatie en documenten met uw naam erop. Deze documenten lagen op het bureau van rechter Gareth Bull, hoofd van de afdeling Geldafwikkeling. Na nadere bestudering en navraag werd bevestigd dat er tegoeden ter waarde van Ђ 5,2 miljoen op uw naam nog steeds niet zijn opgeлist en dat deze als achtergelaten zijn gecategoriseerd vanwege het niet naleven van de vereisten voor de afhandeling en procedurekosten.



Hoewel ik niet eerder door u als juridisch adviseur was ingeschakeld, voelde ik mij te goeder trouw en op grond van mijn professionele ethische plicht genoodzaakt u van de situatie op de hoogte te stellen. Deze kwestie is van ernstig juridisch belang en kan aanleiding geven tot frauduleuze claims, vooral omdat mij is meegedeeld dat verschillende derden hebben geprobeerd het eigendom van de genoemde gelden te claimen. Sommigen beweren – zonder verificatie – dat u overleden bent, naar verluidt als gevolg van de COVID-19-pandemie, en verklaren zich daardoor tot uw nabestaande.

Laat ik eerlijk zijn: de aanhoudende vertragingen en complicaties rond de vrijgave van uw gelden zijn het gevolg van herhaaldelijke verwaarlozing van juridische procedures en een gebrek aan officiлle juridische vertegenwoordiging. Talrijke cliлnten worden het slachtoffer van aanhoudende kostenclaims omdat ze vertrouwen op tussenpersonen die geen wettelijke bevoegdheid hebben, wat vaak leidt tot een voortdurende cyclus van eindeloze kosten zonder oplossing.



Ons juridisch voorstel

David Moore & Associates Law Firm is bereid u officieel te vertegenwoordigen en onmiddellijk stappen te ondernemen om:



Namens u de vereiste verklaringen te beлdigen en in te dienen.



Een aanvraag in te dienen voor wettelijke kwijtschelding van de kosten voor de afhandeling.

Verkrijg een bevel tot directe vrijlating van het Ministerie van Justitie op basis van de wettelijke bevoegdheid.



Deze procedure duurt, zodra deze is gestart, ongeveer 2-3 werkdagen. Daarna kunt u uw geld storten op een in de VS gevestigde rekening van uw gekozen bank, afhankelijk van uw voorkeur en juridische toegankelijkheid.



Juridische kosten en opdrachtvoorwaarden

Om deze procedure te starten, bedragen de totale kosten voor het opstellen en indienen van de aanvraag voor de verklaringen en afstand van recht Ђ 820,00. Ter ondersteuning van uw zaak is ons kantoor bereid Ђ 420,00 te subsidiлren en verzoeken wij u de resterende $ 400,00 bij te dragen. Dit zijn de enige vooruitbetalingen die van u worden verlangd.



Onze overeengekomen juridische kosten bedragen Ђ 10.750,00, te betalen na succesvolle ontvangst van uw geld. U bent niet verplicht dit uit eigen middelen te betalen; dit wordt verrekend met het teruggevorderde geld. Eventuele extra fooien of prestatiegerelateerde bonussen die u boven dit bedrag aanbiedt, zijn geheel naar eigen goeddunken. Onmiddellijke actie vereist

Gezien de gevoeligheid en urgentie van deze zaak verzoeken wij u onverwijld het volgende te doen:



Bevestig uw voornemen om onze diensten in te schakelen schriftelijk.

Vereffen de bijdrage van $ 400, bij voorkeur via Bitcoin Wallet Payment, Apple-cadeaubonnen in coupures van Ђ 50 of Ђ 100, inclusief aankoopbewijzen. Deze methode stelt ons in staat om het geld snel om te zetten en toe te wijzen om de kosten van het indienen te dekken.



Na ontvangst van het bovenstaande zal ons juridische team dezelfde dag nog met uw dossier beginnen. Behandel deze zaak met de ernst die het verdient, aangezien langdurig inactief zijn ertoe kan leiden dat uw geld verbeurd wordt verklaard aan de staat op grond van de bestaande financiлle wetgeving of ten onrechte wordt geclaimd door imitators.

We blijven beschikbaar voor verdere toelichting. Beantwoord deze e-mail zo snel mogelijk, zodat we hiermee verder kunnen gaan.



Hoogachtend,

DAVID GRAHAM MOORE ESQ.

Senior Legal Counsel

David Moore & Associates LLP

My email to you is in respect of an unclaimed contract inheritance funds in your name presently floating in a suspense account. Our team has been working to identify and verify legitimate claims, and your name has been associated with one such case.



As part of our mandate, we are collaborating with relevant authorities to ensure that genuine claims are processed and funds are released to their rightful owners. I am in position to verify and vet the release of the money to you if we agree on the formula that covers both the process that will lead to the release of the money and the sharing of the money when released. I will provide more details if you agree to work with me on this project.



Please let me know if you would like to proceed, and I will be happy to provide detailed information.



Kindest regards,

Daniel Egoamaka.

SA to the DG of FRAN.

messages.subject: Re: A Claim tied to your name.
messages.body:
Hello Mr. Egoamaka,

What exactly is FRAN? Is it a real government agency? Who is the Director-General, and what’s your office address?

Which contract is in my name—company, date, amount (exact total to the cent), and a case/reference number? Also, write the full name and address you have on file so I can confirm you’ve got the right person. How did you get my email?

I don’t click links or open attachments—please paste details in the email.

What do you mean by “formula”? Step-by-step, very simple. Are there any fees? I don’t send money.

Please provide a government email (not Gmail), your ID, and a direct office phone. I can try calling later tomorrow—my parrot, Captain Biscuits, is squawking and my tomatoes need watering.

Best wishes,
James

I genuinely want to honor our late client’s wishes, and I’m seeking your
permission to work together in claiming this insurance benefit. If you

I would greatly appreciate your prompt response if you’re interested in

Thank you,
Daniel Godden

Berkeley Square Solicitors
Telephone: +44 740 581 1576

Yours faithfully,



Hon. Mr. Justice Olukayode Ariwoola GCON

Chief Justice of Nigeria

Hon. Mr. Justice Olukayode Ariwoola GCON

Dear sir/Madam,

My name is Mr. Michael Rigas, Financial Secretary at the U.S. Department of the Treasury. During a recent audit of pending payment files, I identified a transaction in your name for the sum of USD $5.5 million, reference number UST/230/XX025. This payment has been duly approved by the U.S. Federal Government, with the U.S. Department Bank designated as the authorized paying institution.



While reviewing the file, I came across correspondence from Mr. Brian Morgan, who claims to be acting on your behalf. According to his submission, you have been diagnosed with a terminal illness (lung cancer) and are unable to personally oversee your financial affairs. He has therefore requested that the approved funds be transferred to him as your next of kin and business associate.



To protect your interests, I have placed a temporary hold on the processing of this payment until I receive direct confirmation from you. Please clarify at your earliest convenience:



Did you authorize Mr. Brian Morgan to act on your behalf regarding this payment?



If you are unaware of Mr. Morgan’s involvement, kindly notify me immediately. Upon your confirmation, arrangements can be made for the prompt release of your funds—either by visiting our office in person or by providing your designated receiving bank details.



For your security, please refrain from further communication with third parties concerning this payment. The U.S. Department Bank will not assume responsibility for any losses arising from unauthorized dealings or misdirection of funds.



I strongly urge you to treat this matter with urgency to avoid unnecessary delays. Should you require clarification or assistance, do not hesitate to contact me directly.



Sincerely,

Mr. Michael Rigas

Financial Secretary

U.S. Department of the Treasury
